I could go over this in greater detail later, but on the Sims we used an advertising based method. Your sim had a list of attributes, bathroom, hunger, entertainment, etc. As those values hit thresholds a motivation would be triggered (find a bathroom, etc).

Every interactive object would advertise what attributes it would modify. So when your sim was near a fridge it would advertise -3 hunger, -1 money. The sim would then make state based decisions. I'm in a phone so that's about as deep add I can get now. Hope that helps.

Here is a paper that explains a Needs-Based AI that the Sims uses. Needs-Based AI

Basically, Sims have needs, objects broadcast what needs they can fill.

Simple Example:

  • Sim has Hunger need.

  • Fridge is broadcasting that it restores hunger.

  • Sim goes to Fridge to restore hunger.
